You are being scored right now. Not by a teacher, not by a boss, and not by a credit bureau. Those familiar judges are not deciding how the model responds.

The system estimates how dangerous you might be, and it measures how much effort the model should spend on you. The two dials can lead to different decisions.

Then it assigns a hidden score you will never see. You cannot appeal it, and you can barely prove it exists. The final decision stays behind frosted glass.
